queryLines:
SELECT
  f.id,
  f.created_at,
  f.message_id,
  f.vote,
  f.comment,
  COALESCE(u.email, 'Unknown user') AS email,
  u.display_name,
  m.old_filename,
  m.new_filename,
  m.volume_session_path,
  m.processing_method,
  CONCAT(
    'https://dbc-c623749d-731b.cloud.databricks.com/explore/data/volumes/dev_proj/qualibot/doc_compare?o=2865348338307293&volumePath=',
    REPLACE(CONCAT(m.volume_session_path, '/'), '/', '%2F'),
    '&filePreviewPath=old_',
    REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(m.old_filename, ' ', '_'), '!', '_'), '(', ''), ')', '_')
  ) AS lien_ancien,
  CONCAT(
    'https://dbc-c623749d-731b.cloud.databricks.com/explore/data/volumes/dev_proj/qualibot/doc_compare?o=2865348338307293&volumePath=',
    REPLACE(CONCAT(m.volume_session_path, '/'), '/', '%2F'),
    '&filePreviewPath=new_',
    REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(m.new_filename, ' ', '_'), '!', '_'), '(', ''), ')', '_')
  ) AS lien_nouveau,
  CONCAT(
    'https://dbc-c623749d-731b.cloud.databricks.com/explore/data/volumes/dev_proj/qualibot/doc_compare?o=2865348338307293&volumePath=',
    REPLACE(CONCAT(m.volume_session_path, '/'), '/', '%2F'),
    '&filePreviewPath=analyse.md'
  ) AS lien_analyse
FROM
  dev_proj.qualibot.compare_feedbacks f
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        user_id,
        MAX(REPLACE(REPLACE(email, '\n', ''), '\r', '')) AS email,
        MAX(display_name) AS display_name,
        FLATTEN(COLLECT_SET(groups)) AS groups
      FROM
        dev_proj.qualibot.users
      GROUP BY
        user_id
    ) u
      ON f.user_id = u.user_id
    LEFT JOIN dev_proj.qualibot.compare_messages m
      ON f.message_id = m.id
WHERE
  NOT array_contains(
    COALESCE(u.groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
    'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreDev'
  )
  AND NOT array_contains(
    COALESCE(u.groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
    'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreAdmin'
  )ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

  SELECT
    id,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    user_id,
    REPLACE(REPLACE(email, '\n', ''), '\r', '') AS email,
    display_name,
    workspace_url,

    can_compare,
    groups,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

          CASE

            ELSE 1

    dev_proj.qualibot.users

datasets.name: analyses_temporelles
queryLines:
WITH user_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    MAX(REPLACE(REPLACE(email, '\n', ''), '\r', '')) AS email,
    FLATTEN(COLLECT_SET(groups)) AS groups
  FROM
    dev_proj.qualibot.users
  GROUP BY
    user_id
),
messages_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    m.id,
    m.created_at
  FROM
    dev_proj.qualibot.compare_messages m
      LEFT JOIN user_lookup u
        ON m.user_id = u.user_id
  WHERE
    NOT array_contains(
      COALESCE(u.groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
      'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreDev'
    )
    AND NOT array_contains(
      COALESCE(u.groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
      'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreAdmin'
    )
    AND m.analysis_text IS NOT NULL
),
date_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(DATE(created_at)) AS min_d,
    MAX(DATE(created_at)) AS max_d
  FROM
    messages_filtered
),
day_spine AS (
  SELECT
    EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(min_d, max_d, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS dt
  FROM
    date_bounds
),
working_days AS (
  SELECT
    dt
  FROM
    day_spine
  WHERE
    DAYOFWEEK(dt) NOT IN (1, 7)
    OR dt IN (SELECT DATE(created_at) FROM messages_filtered)
),
daily AS (
  SELECT
    s.dt AS periode,
    COUNT(mf.id) AS analyses
  FROM
    working_days s
      LEFT JOIN messages_filtered mf
        ON DATE(mf.created_at) = s.dt
  GROUP BY
    s.dt
),
weekly AS (
  SELECT
    s.periode,
    COUNT(mf.id) AS analyses
  FROM (
    SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('week', min_d) AS DATE), CAST(DATE_TRUNC('week', max_d) AS DATE), INTERVAL 7 DAYS)) AS periode
    FROM date_bounds
  ) s
    LEFT JOIN messages_filtered mf
      ON CAST(DATE_TRUNC('week', DATE(mf.created_at)) AS DATE) = s.periode
  GROUP BY s.periode
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT
    s.periode,
    COUNT(mf.id) AS analyses
  FROM (
    SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', min_d) AS DATE), CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', max_d) AS DATE), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS periode
    FROM date_bounds
  ) s
    LEFT JOIN messages_filtered mf
      ON CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE(mf.created_at)) AS DATE) = s.periode
  GROUP BY s.periode
)
SELECT
  *
FROM
  daily
WHERE
  :temporalite = 'Day'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  *
FROM
  weekly
WHERE
  :temporalite = 'Week'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  *
FROM
  monthly
WHERE
  :temporalite = 'Month'

datasets.name: user_growth
queryLines:
WITH excluded_by_group AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    REPLACE(REPLACE(email, '\n', ''), '\r', '') AS email
  FROM
    dev_proj.qualibot.users
  WHERE
    array_contains(COALESCE(groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)), 'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreDev')
    OR array_contains(
      COALESCE(groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
      'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreAdmin'
    )
),
users_deduped AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    MIN(created_at) AS created_at,
    MAX(REPLACE(REPLACE(email, '\n', ''), '\r', '')) AS email,
    FLATTEN(COLLECT_SET(groups)) AS groups
  FROM
    dev_proj.qualibot.users
  GROUP BY
    user_id
),
users_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(created_at) AS date_event
  FROM
    users_deduped
  WHERE
    NOT array_contains(
      COALESCE(groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
      'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreDev'
    )
    AND NOT array_contains(
      COALESCE(groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
      'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreAdmin'
    )
),
daily_signups AS (
  SELECT
    date_event,
    COUNT(*) AS nouveaux,
    'First use' AS source
  FROM
    users_filtered
  GROUP BY
    date_event
),
adds_doccompare AS (
  SELECT
    request_params['targetUserName'] AS user_email,
    MIN(event_date) AS first_added
  FROM
    system.access.audit
  WHERE
    action_name = 'addPrincipalToGroup'
    AND request_params['targetGroupName'] = 'Role-Project-LEAP-End-users-Qualibot-DocCompare'
    AND response.status_code = 200
    AND request_params['targetUserName'] NOT IN (SELECT email FROM excluded_by_group WHERE email IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY
    1
),
daily_adds_doccompare AS (
  SELECT
    first_added AS date_event,
    COUNT(*) AS nouveaux,
    'DocCompare Rights' AS source
  FROM
    adds_doccompare
  GROUP BY
    first_added
),
adds_chatbot AS (
  SELECT
    request_params['targetUserName'] AS user_email,
    MIN(event_date) AS first_added
  FROM
    system.access.audit
  WHERE
    action_name = 'addPrincipalToGroup'
    AND request_params['targetGroupName'] = 'Role-Project-LEAP-End-users-Qualibot-ChatBot'
    AND response.status_code = 200
    AND request_params['targetUserName'] NOT IN (SELECT email FROM excluded_by_group WHERE email IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY
    1
),
daily_adds_chatbot AS (
  SELECT
    first_added AS date_event,
    COUNT(*) AS nouveaux,
    'ChatBot Rights' AS source
  FROM
    adds_chatbot
  GROUP BY
    first_added
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    daily_signups
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    daily_adds_doccompare
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    daily_adds_chatbot
),
sparse_cumul AS (
  SELECT
    date_event AS date_inscription,
    source,
    SUM(nouveaux) OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY date_event) AS cumul_utilisateurs
  FROM
    combined
),
date_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(date_inscription) AS min_d,
    MAX(date_inscription) AS max_d
  FROM
    sparse_cumul
),
all_dates AS (
  SELECT
    EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(min_d, max_d, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS dt
  FROM
    date_bounds
),
all_sources AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    source
  FROM
    sparse_cumul
),
grid AS (
  SELECT
    d.dt AS date_inscription,
    s.source
  FROM
    all_dates d CROSS JOIN all_sources s
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    g.date_inscription,
    g.source,
    sc.cumul_utilisateurs
  FROM
    grid g
      LEFT JOIN sparse_cumul sc
        ON g.date_inscription = sc.date_inscription
        AND g.source = sc.source
),
filled AS (
  SELECT
    date_inscription,
    source,
    LAST_VALUE(cumul_utilisateurs, true) OVER (
        PARTITION BY source
        ORDER BY date_inscription
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) AS cumul_utilisateurs
  FROM
    joined
)
SELECT
  *
FROM
  filled
WHERE
  cumul_utilisateurs IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  date_inscription

datasets.name: kpis_adoption
queryLines:
WITH user_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    MAX(REPLACE(REPLACE(email, '\n', ''), '\r', '')) AS email,
    MIN(created_at) AS first_created_at,
    FLATTEN(COLLECT_SET(groups)) AS groups
  FROM
    dev_proj.qualibot.users
  GROUP BY
    user_id
)
SELECT
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM
      user_lookup
    WHERE
      NOT array_contains(
        COALESCE(groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
        'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreDev'
      )
      AND NOT array_contains(
        COALESCE(groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
        'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreAdmin'
      )
      AND first_created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE())
  ) AS inscrits_ce_mois,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM
      dev_proj.qualibot.compare_messages m
        LEFT JOIN user_lookup u
          ON m.user_id = u.user_id
    WHERE
      NOT array_contains(
        COALESCE(u.groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
        'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreDev'
      )
      AND NOT array_contains(
        COALESCE(u.groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
        'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreAdmin'
      )
      AND m.analysis_text IS NOT NULL
      AND m.created_at >= DATEADD(WEEK, -1, DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE()))
      AND m.created_at < DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE())
  ) AS analyses_sem_derniere,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM
      dev_proj.qualibot.chat_messages cm
        LEFT JOIN user_lookup u
          ON cm.user_id = u.user_id
    WHERE
      NOT array_contains(
        COALESCE(u.groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
        'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreDev'
      )
      AND NOT array_contains(
        COALESCE(u.groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
        'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreAdmin'
      )
      AND cm.role = 'user'
      AND cm.deleted = false
      AND CAST(cm.created_at AS TIMESTAMP) >= DATEADD(WEEK, -1, DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE()))
      AND CAST(cm.created_at AS TIMESTAMP) < DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE())
  ) AS questions_chat_sem_derniere

datasets.name: adoption_droits
queryLines:
WITH excluded_by_group AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    REPLACE(REPLACE(email, '\n', ''), '\r', '') AS email
  FROM
    dev_proj.qualibot.users
  WHERE
    array_contains(COALESCE(groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)), 'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreDev')
    OR array_contains(
      COALESCE(groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
      'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreAdmin'
    )
),
adds_dc AS (
  SELECT
    request_params['targetUserName'] AS user_email,
    MAX(event_date) AS last_added
  FROM
    system.access.audit
  WHERE
    action_name = 'addPrincipalToGroup'
    AND request_params['targetGroupName'] = 'Role-Project-LEAP-End-users-Qualibot-DocCompare'
    AND response.status_code = 200
  GROUP BY
    1
),
removes_dc AS (
  SELECT
    request_params['targetUserName'] AS user_email,
    MAX(event_date) AS last_removed
  FROM
    system.access.audit
  WHERE
    action_name = 'removePrincipalFromGroup'
    AND request_params['targetGroupName'] = 'Role-Project-LEAP-End-users-Qualibot-DocCompare'
    AND response.status_code = 200
  GROUP BY
    1
),
members_dc AS (
  SELECT
    a.user_email,
    'DocCompare' AS outil
  FROM
    adds_dc a
      LEFT JOIN removes_dc r
        ON a.user_email = r.user_email
  WHERE
    (
      r.user_email IS NULL
      OR a.last_added > r.last_removed
    )
    AND a.user_email NOT IN (SELECT email FROM excluded_by_group WHERE email IS NOT NULL)
),
adds_cb AS (
  SELECT
    request_params['targetUserName'] AS user_email,
    MAX(event_date) AS last_added
  FROM
    system.access.audit
  WHERE
    action_name = 'addPrincipalToGroup'
    AND request_params['targetUserName'] LIKE '%@%'
    AND request_params['targetGroupName'] IN ('Role-Project-LEAP-End-users-Qualibot-ChatBot', 'Role-LATECOERE-User-Internal')
    AND response.status_code = 200
  GROUP BY
    1
),
removes_cb AS (
  SELECT
    request_params['targetUserName'] AS user_email,
    MAX(event_date) AS last_removed
  FROM
    system.access.audit
  WHERE
    action_name = 'removePrincipalFromGroup'
    AND request_params['targetGroupName'] IN ('Role-Project-LEAP-End-users-Qualibot-ChatBot', 'Role-LATECOERE-User-Internal')
    AND response.status_code = 200
  GROUP BY
    1
),
members_cb AS (
  SELECT
    a.user_email,
    'ChatBot' AS outil
  FROM
    adds_cb a
      LEFT JOIN removes_cb r
        ON a.user_email = r.user_email
  WHERE
    (
      r.user_email IS NULL
      OR a.last_added > r.last_removed
    )
    AND a.user_email NOT IN (SELECT email FROM excluded_by_group WHERE email IS NOT NULL)
),
user_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    MAX(REPLACE(REPLACE(email, '\n', ''), '\r', '')) AS email,
    FLATTEN(COLLECT_SET(groups)) AS groups
  FROM
    dev_proj.qualibot.users
  GROUP BY
    user_id
),
active_dc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(u.email, 'unknown') AS email
  FROM
    dev_proj.qualibot.compare_messages m
      LEFT JOIN user_lookup u
        ON m.user_id = u.user_id
  WHERE
    m.analysis_text IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT array_contains(
      COALESCE(u.groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
      'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreDev'
    )
    AND NOT array_contains(
      COALESCE(u.groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
      'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreAdmin'
    )
),
active_cb AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(u.email, 'unknown') AS email
  FROM
    dev_proj.qualibot.chat_messages cm
      LEFT JOIN user_lookup u
        ON cm.user_id = u.user_id
  WHERE
    cm.role = 'user'
    AND cm.deleted = false
    AND NOT array_contains(
      COALESCE(u.groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
      'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreDev'
    )
    AND NOT array_contains(
      COALESCE(u.groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
      'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreAdmin'
    )
),
all_members AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    members_dc
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    members_cb
)
SELECT
  am.user_email,
  am.outil,
  CASE
    WHEN
      am.outil = 'DocCompare'
      AND adc.email IS NOT NULL
    THEN
      1
    WHEN
      am.outil = 'ChatBot'
      AND acb.email IS NOT NULL
    THEN
      1
    ELSE 0
  END AS est_actif
FROM
  all_members am
    LEFT JOIN active_dc adc
      ON LOWER(am.user_email) = LOWER(adc.email)
      AND am.outil = 'DocCompare'
    LEFT JOIN active_cb acb
      ON LOWER(am.user_email) = LOWER(acb.email)
      AND am.outil = 'ChatBot'

columns.expression: CASE WHEN est_actif = 1 THEN 'Used' ELSE 'Not used' END

datasets.name: chat_data
queryLines:
SELECT
  m.id,
  m.user_id,
  m.created_at,
  m.content,
  m.role,
  m.session_id,
  m.division,
  m.endpoint_name,
  m.error_msg,
  m.sources_json,
  m.status,
  m.trace_id,
  tt.mlflow_trace_id,
  m.deleted,
  m.question_lang,
  s.name AS session_name,
  s.created_at AS session_created_at,
  s.share_token,
  COALESCE(u.email, 'Unknown user') AS email,
  u.display_name,
  fb.vote AS feedback_vote,
  fb.comment AS feedback_comment,
  LAST_VALUE(
    CASE
      WHEN
        m.role = 'user'
      THEN
        CASE
          WHEN
            m.content LIKE '[Division:%'
            AND LOCATE('state it explicitly.', m.content) > 0
          THEN
            REGEXP_REPLACE(
              SUBSTRING(m.content, LOCATE('state it explicitly.', m.content) + 20),
              '^[\n\r ]+',
              ''
            )
          ELSE m.content
        END
    END
  )
    IGNORE NULLS OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.session_id
      ORDER BY m.created_at
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
    ) AS user_question
FROM
  dev_proj.qualibot.chat_messages m
    LEFT JOIN dev_proj.qualibot.chat_sessions s
      ON m.session_id = s.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        user_id,
        MAX(REPLACE(REPLACE(email, '\n', ''), '\r', '')) AS email,
        MAX(display_name) AS display_name,
        FLATTEN(COLLECT_SET(groups)) AS groups
      FROM
        dev_proj.qualibot.users
      GROUP BY
        user_id
    ) u
      ON m.user_id = u.user_id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        message_id,
        vote,
        comment,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY message_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rn
      FROM
        dev_proj.qualibot.chat_feedbacks
    ) fb
      ON m.id = fb.message_id
      AND fb.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT assistant_message_id, MAX(mlflow_trace_id) AS mlflow_trace_id FROM dev_proj.qualibot.chat_turns WHERE mlflow_trace_id IS NOT NULL AND mlflow_trace_id != '' GROUP BY assistant_message_id) tt
      ON m.id = tt.assistant_message_id
WHERE
  NOT array_contains(
    COALESCE(u.groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
    'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreDev'
  )
  AND NOT array_contains(
    COALESCE(u.groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),

WITH user_lookup AS (

all_msgs AS (
  SELECT

    s.name AS session_name,
    COALESCE(u.email, 'Unknown user') AS email,
    u.display_name,
    fb.vote AS feedback_vote,
    fb.comment AS feedback_comment,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY m.session_id
        ORDER BY CAST(m.created_at AS TIMESTAMP), m.id
      ) AS msg_rn,
    MIN(CAST(m.created_at AS TIMESTAMP)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.session_id) AS debut_session,
    s.share_token
  FROM
    dev_proj.qualibot.chat_messages m
      LEFT JOIN dev_proj.qualibot.chat_sessions s
        ON m.session_id = s.id
      LEFT JOIN user_lookup u
        ON m.user_id = u.user_id
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
          message_id,
          vote,
          comment,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY message_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rn
        FROM
          dev_proj.qualibot.chat_feedbacks
      ) fb
        ON m.id = fb.message_id
        AND fb.rn = 1
  WHERE
    m.deleted = false
    AND COALESCE(u.email, '') NOT IN ('sam.crawshayjones@latecoere.aero', 'yann.depledt.external@latecoere.aero', 'brice.appenzeller.external@latecoere.aero', 'jules.gourio.external@latecoere.aero')

    )
    AND NOT array_contains(
      COALESCE(u.groups, CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRING>)),
      'Role-Project-LEAP-CoreAdmin'
    )
),
user_msgs AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY msg_rn) AS question_num
  FROM
    all_msgs
  WHERE
    role = 'user'
),
asst_next_rn AS (
  SELECT
    u.id AS user_msg_id,
    MIN(a.msg_rn) AS next_asst_rn
  FROM
    user_msgs u
      JOIN all_msgs a
        ON a.session_id = u.session_id
        AND a.role = 'assistant'
        AND a.msg_rn > u.msg_rn
  GROUP BY
    u.id
)
SELECT
  DATE(u.debut_session) AS session_date,
  u.debut_session,
  u.question_num AS ordre,
  REPLACE(u.email, '@latecoere.aero', '') AS Utilisateur,
  u.email,
  u.division,
  CASE
    WHEN
      u.content LIKE '[Division:%'
      AND LOCATE('state it explicitly.', u.content) > 0
    THEN
      REGEXP_REPLACE(
        SUBSTRING(u.content, LOCATE('state it explicitly.', u.content) + 20),
        '^[\n\r ]+',
        ''
      )
    ELSE u.content
  END AS question,
  a.content AS reponse,
  a.sources_json,
  a.feedback_vote,
  a.feedback_comment,
  u.session_id,
  u.session_name,
  u.question_lang,
  COALESCE(hr.Workplace,
    CASE
      WHEN u.email IN ('andrea.matyskova@latecoere.aero', 'tomas.myslivec@latecoere.aero', 'tomas.sindelar@latecoere.aero') THEN 'Praha'
      WHEN u.email IN ('armando.tapia@latecoere.aero', 'brianda.penunuri@latecoere.aero', 'estefania.aldana@latecoere.aero', 'hector.galindo@latecoere.aero', 'iveth.herrejon@latecoere.aero', 'karim.quijada@latecoere.aero', 'marco.loya@latecoere.aero', 'maria.valenzuela@latecoere.aero') THEN 'Hermosillo'
    END
  ) AS workplace,
  CONCAT('https://qualibot-2865348338307293.aws.databricksapps.com/chat/shared/', u.share_token) AS share_link,
  CASE WHEN tt.mlflow_trace_id RLIKE '^trace:/[^/]*[.][0-9]+/' THEN CONCAT('https://dbc-c623749d-731b.cloud.databricks.com/ml/experiments/', REGEXP_EXTRACT(tt.mlflow_trace_id, '^trace:/[^/]*[.]([0-9]+)/', 1), '/traces?o=2865348338307293&selectedEvaluationId=', REPLACE(REPLACE(tt.mlflow_trace_id, ':', '%3A'), '/', '%2F')) WHEN tt.mlflow_trace_id IS NOT NULL AND tt.mlflow_trace_id != '' AND '' != '' THEN CONCAT('https://dbc-c623749d-731b.cloud.databricks.com/ml/experiments/None/traces?o=2865348338307293&selectedEvaluationId=', REPLACE(REPLACE(tt.mlflow_trace_id, ':', '%3A'), '/', '%2F')) WHEN a.trace_id RLIKE '^tr-[0-9a-f]{32}$' THEN CONCAT('https://dbc-c623749d-731b.cloud.databricks.com/ml/experiments/', CASE WHEN u.division = 'AS' THEN '2748374992560664' WHEN u.division = 'IS' THEN '2748374992560665' ELSE '4171178917767011' END, '/traces?o=2865348338307293&selectedEvaluationId=', a.trace_id) ELSE NULL END AS trace_link
FROM
  user_msgs u
    LEFT JOIN asst_next_rn an
      ON u.id = an.user_msg_id
    LEFT JOIN all_msgs a
      ON a.session_id = u.session_id
      AND a.msg_rn = an.next_asst_rn
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT assistant_message_id, MAX(mlflow_trace_id) AS mlflow_trace_id FROM dev_proj.qualibot.chat_turns WHERE mlflow_trace_id IS NOT NULL AND mlflow_trace_id != '' GROUP BY assistant_message_id) tt ON tt.assistant_message_id = a.id
    LEFT JOIN (

          Workplace,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(CONCAT(First_name, Last_name)), '[^a-z]', '')
            ORDER BY CASE WHEN Status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, _leap_extraction_date DESC

        WHERE _leap_extraction_date = (SELECT MAX(_leap_extraction_date) FROM sd_prod_gold.hr.hr_workforce_gold_finance_view_monthly)

    ) hr ON REGEXP_REPLACE(
      LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(u.email, '.external@latecoere.aero', '@latecoere.aero'), '@latecoere.aero', '')),
      '[^a-z]', ''

WITH true_errors AS (
  SELECT
    IDDOC, ref, source_file_name, error_trace,
    date(ingestion_timestamp) AS since,
    CAST(datediff(current_date(), ingestion_timestamp) AS INT) AS days,
    'ERROR' AS category,
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS n_chunks,
    source_file_extension,
    ROUND(source_file_size_bytes / 1024.0, 1) AS file_size_kb
  FROM dev_proj.qualibot.parsed_documents
  WHERE parse_status = 'ERROR'
),
current_backlog AS (
  SELECT IDDOC, ref, source_file_name, source_file_extension, source_file_size_bytes, date(ingestion_timestamp) AS ingested_on
  FROM dev_proj.qualibot.parsed_documents
  WHERE parse_status = 'EMPTY_TEXT'
),
backlog_history AS (
  SELECT e.IDDOC, min(run_date) AS first_seen
  FROM dev_proj.qualibot.parsing_run_health t
  LATERAL VIEW explode(t.errors) exploded AS e
  WHERE e.parse_status = 'EMPTY_TEXT'
  GROUP BY e.IDDOC
),
chunk_counts AS (
  SELECT IDDOC, count(*) AS n_chunks FROM dev_proj.qualibot.chunks GROUP BY IDDOC
),
needs_ocr AS (
  SELECT
    cb.IDDOC, cb.ref,
    cb.source_file_name,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS error_trace,
    COALESCE(h.first_seen, cb.ingested_on) AS since,
    CAST(datediff(current_date(), COALESCE(h.first_seen, cb.ingested_on)) AS INT) AS days,
    'NEEDS_OCR' AS category,
    COALESCE(cc.n_chunks, 0) AS n_chunks,
    cb.source_file_extension,
    ROUND(cb.source_file_size_bytes / 1024.0, 1) AS file_size_kb
  FROM current_backlog cb
  LEFT JOIN backlog_history h ON h.IDDOC = cb.IDDOC
  LEFT JOIN chunk_counts cc ON cc.IDDOC = cb.IDDOC
)
SELECT * FROM true_errors
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM needs_ocr
ORDER BY category, since

),
other_costs AS (
  SELECT
    u.usage_date,
    u.workspace_id,
    u.billing_origin_product,
    u.sku_name,
    u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name AS endpoint_name,
    u.usage_metadata.app_name AS app_name,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS dbus,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS cost_usd
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
      AND u.cloud = lp.cloud
      AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
      AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time)
  WHERE
    u.usage_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
    AND (
      -- Vector Search: the ONE endpoint that exists in this workspace
      -- (live-checked 2026-09-03), and it hosts only Qualibot's 3 indexes.
      (
        u.billing_origin_product = 'VECTOR_SEARCH'
        AND (u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name = 'qualibot' OR u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name ILIKE 'ka-%-vs-endpoint')
      )
      -- Knowledge Assistants (Agent Bricks serving)
      OR (
        u.billing_origin_product = 'AGENT_BRICKS'
        AND u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name ILIKE 'ka-%'
        AND u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name NOT IN ('ka-df2b7829-endpoint')
      )
      -- Apps: doc-compare (qualibot / qualibot-uat-test) + qualibot-translate*
      OR (
        u.billing_origin_product = 'APPS'
        AND u.usage_metadata.app_name LIKE 'qualibot%'
      )
      -- Lakebase: the exact project Qualibot owns, not every Postgres
      -- project in the workspace (other teams have their own).
      OR (
        u.billing_origin_product = 'LAKEBASE'
        AND u.usage_metadata.project_id IN ('e9185a28-13c6-42da-9ccc-0dbcf6b97b60', 'd9fd81bc-5865-4ef0-8718-520a9e8d6c68', 'deb195f2-6189-419e-a640-b29fa71e540c')
      )
    )
  GROUP BY ALL
),
combined AS (
  SELECT * FROM jobs_cost
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM other_costs
)

    WHEN billing_origin_product = 'VECTOR_SEARCH' THEN 'Vector Search'

    WHEN billing_origin_product = 'LAKEBASE' THEN 'Lakebase Compute'
    ELSE billing_origin_product

    WHEN workspace_id = '1210945332048776' THEN 'PROD (LEAP-Core)'
    ELSE 'OTHER'
  END AS env,

      AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
      AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time)
  WHERE
    u.usage_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
    AND u.billing_origin_product = 'AGENT_BRICKS'
    AND u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name ILIKE 'ka-%'
    AND u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name NOT IN ('ka-df2b7829-endpoint')
  GROUP BY u.usage_date, u.workspace_id, u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name
),
chat_daily AS (
  SELECT 'DEV' AS env, DATE(TRY_CAST(created_at AS TIMESTAMP)) AS usage_date, COUNT(*) AS n_user_messages
  FROM dev_proj.qualibot.chat_messages
  WHERE role = 'user' AND deleted = false
    AND DATE(TRY_CAST(created_at AS TIMESTAMP)) >= current_date() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
  GROUP BY 2
),
env_day_cost AS (
  SELECT usage_date, env, SUM(cost_usd) AS env_cost_usd FROM ka_billing GROUP BY usage_date, env
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT b.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.usage_date, b.env ORDER BY b.cost_usd DESC) AS rn
  FROM ka_billing b
)
SELECT
  r.usage_date,
  r.env,
  r.endpoint_name,
  r.dbus,
  r.cost_usd,
  CASE WHEN r.rn = 1 THEN c.n_user_messages END AS n_user_messages,
  CASE WHEN r.rn = 1 AND r.env = 'DEV' AND COALESCE(c.n_user_messages, 0) > 0
    THEN round(d.env_cost_usd / c.n_user_messages, 4) END AS cost_per_request_dev,
  CASE WHEN r.rn = 1 AND r.env = 'DEV' AND COALESCE(c.n_user_messages, 0) > 0
    THEN round(d.env_cost_usd * 100 / c.n_user_messages, 2) END AS cents_per_request_dev
FROM ranked r
  LEFT JOIN chat_daily c ON r.usage_date = c.usage_date AND r.env = c.env
  LEFT JOIN env_day_cost d ON r.usage_date = d.usage_date AND r.env = d.env
ORDER BY r.usage_date DESC, r.env, r.endpoint_name

queryLines:
WITH change_log AS (
  SELECT
    IDDOC,
    ref AS new_ref,
    event_type,
    old_ref,
    old_indice,
    new_indice,
    old_doc_date,
    new_doc_date,
    job_run_id,
    logged_at
  FROM
    dev_proj.qualibot.document_change_log
),
indexing_latest AS (
  SELECT
    IDDOC,
    parse_status,
    ingestion_timestamp
  FROM
    dev_proj.qualibot.parsed_documents
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IDDOC ORDER BY ingestion_timestamp DESC) = 1
),
scope_check AS (
  SELECT
    document_revision_ID AS IDDOC,
    revision_status_code AS COURANT,
    lifecycle_state_code AS ETAT,
    is_hidden AS NONVISIBLE,
    (revision_status_code = 1 AND lifecycle_state_code = 7 AND is_hidden = false) AS in_qualibot_scope
  FROM
    prod_gold.quality_system.document_revisions_intraqual
),
first_seen AS (
  SELECT
    IDDOC,
    MIN(logged_at) AS first_detected_at
  FROM
    dev_proj.qualibot.document_change_log
  GROUP BY
    IDDOC
),
detection_count AS (
  SELECT
    IDDOC,
    COUNT(*) AS n_detections
  FROM
    dev_proj.qualibot.document_change_log
  GROUP BY
    IDDOC
)
SELECT
  cl.*,
  CASE
    WHEN il.parse_status IN ('OK', 'SUCCESS') THEN 'Indexed'
    WHEN
      il.parse_status IN ('SKIPPED_REF_OUT_OF_SCOPE', 'FILTERED_BY_DATE', 'SKIPPED_IDDOC_NOT_FOUND', 'SKIPPED_SOURCE_REMOVED', 'SKIPPED_EMPTY_SMALL_FILE', 'SKIPPED_REF_MANUAL', 'SKIPPED_CATEGORY_EXCLUDED', 'SKIPPED_SUPERSEDED_REVISION', 'SKIPPED_EMPTY_FOLDER', 'SKIPPED_EMPTY_IMAGES')
      THEN
        'Excluded'
    WHEN il.parse_status IN ('EMPTY_TEXT', 'ERROR', 'TIMEOUT', 'SKIP_TOO_LARGE', 'MISSING_CHUNKS') THEN 'Error'
    WHEN il.IDDOC IS NOT NULL THEN il.parse_status
    WHEN sc.IDDOC IS NULL THEN 'Unknown IDDOC'
    WHEN sc.in_qualibot_scope = false THEN 'Out of scope'
    WHEN
      fs.first_detected_at < current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 48 HOURS
    THEN
      'Stuck (no file on volume)'
    ELSE 'Pending (recent detection)'
  END AS indexing_status,
  CASE
    WHEN il.IDDOC IS NOT NULL THEN il.parse_status
    WHEN sc.IDDOC IS NULL THEN 'IDDOC not found in gd_doc_latest (deleted from Intraqual?)'
    WHEN
      sc.in_qualibot_scope = false
    THEN
      CONCAT('Out of scope: revision_status=', CAST(sc.COURANT AS STRING), ' lifecycle_state=', CAST(sc.ETAT AS STRING), ' hidden=', CAST(sc.NONVISIBLE AS STRING))
    WHEN
      fs.first_detected_at < current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 48 HOURS
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'Volume folder D_',
        cl.IDDOC,
        ' empty or missing — re-detected ',
        dc.n_detections,
        'x since ',
        DATE_FORMAT(fs.first_detected_at, 'MMM dd'),
        ' (no parsed_documents row)'
      )
    ELSE 'Recently detected, next pipeline run at 04:00 CET'
  END AS parse_status,
  il.ingestion_timestamp AS last_indexed_at
FROM
  change_log cl
    LEFT JOIN indexing_latest il
      ON cl.IDDOC = il.IDDOC
    LEFT JOIN scope_check sc
      ON cl.IDDOC = sc.IDDOC
    LEFT JOIN first_seen fs
      ON cl.IDDOC = fs.IDDOC
    LEFT JOIN detection_count dc
      ON cl.IDDOC = dc.IDDOC
ORDER BY
  cl.logged_at DESC

      ELSE 'Not processed'

      LEFT JOIN (

datasets.name: qb_cost_hourly
queryLines:
WITH jobs_cost AS (
  SELECT
    u.usage_date,
    date_trunc('HOUR', u.usage_start_time) AS usage_hour,
    u.workspace_id,
    'JOBS' AS billing_origin_product,
    u.sku_name,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS endpoint_name,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS app_name,
    u.usage_metadata.job_name AS job_name,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS dbus,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS cost_usd
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND u.cloud = lp.cloud
        AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
        AND (
          lp.price_end_time IS NULL
          OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time
        )
  WHERE
    u.usage_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
    AND u.billing_origin_product = 'JOBS'
    AND (
      lower(u.usage_metadata.job_name) LIKE '%qualibot%'
      OR u.custom_tags['project'] = 'Qualibot'
    )
  GROUP BY
    ALL
),
other_costs AS (
  SELECT
    u.usage_date,
    date_trunc('HOUR', u.usage_start_time) AS usage_hour,
    u.workspace_id,
    u.billing_origin_product,
    u.sku_name,
    u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name AS endpoint_name,
    u.usage_metadata.app_name AS app_name,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS job_name,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS dbus,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS cost_usd
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND u.cloud = lp.cloud
        AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
        AND (
          lp.price_end_time IS NULL
          OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time
        )
  WHERE
    u.usage_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
    AND (
      (
        u.billing_origin_product = 'VECTOR_SEARCH'
        AND (u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name = 'qualibot' OR u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name ILIKE 'ka-%-vs-endpoint')
      )
      OR (
        u.billing_origin_product = 'AGENT_BRICKS'
        AND u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name ILIKE 'ka-%'
        AND u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name NOT IN ('ka-df2b7829-endpoint')
      )
      OR (
        u.billing_origin_product = 'APPS'
        AND u.usage_metadata.app_name LIKE 'qualibot%'
      )
      OR (
        u.billing_origin_product = 'LAKEBASE'
        AND u.usage_metadata.project_id IN ('e9185a28-13c6-42da-9ccc-0dbcf6b97b60', 'd9fd81bc-5865-4ef0-8718-520a9e8d6c68', 'deb195f2-6189-419e-a640-b29fa71e540c')
      )
    )
  GROUP BY
    ALL
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    jobs_cost
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    other_costs
)
SELECT
  usage_date,
  usage_hour,
  CASE
    WHEN billing_origin_product = 'JOBS' THEN 'Jobs'
    WHEN billing_origin_product = 'APPS' THEN 'Apps'
    WHEN billing_origin_product = 'VECTOR_SEARCH' AND endpoint_name ILIKE 'ka-%' THEN 'Vector Search (old KA endpoints)'
    WHEN billing_origin_product = 'VECTOR_SEARCH' THEN 'Vector Search'
    WHEN billing_origin_product = 'AGENT_BRICKS' THEN 'KA Serving'
    WHEN
      billing_origin_product = 'LAKEBASE'
      AND sku_name LIKE '%STORAGE%'
    THEN
      'Lakebase Storage'
    WHEN billing_origin_product = 'LAKEBASE' THEN 'Lakebase Compute'
    ELSE billing_origin_product
  END AS cost_category,
  -- Sub-category for more detail
  CASE
    WHEN billing_origin_product = 'JOBS' THEN COALESCE(job_name, 'unknown job')
    WHEN billing_origin_product = 'APPS' THEN COALESCE(app_name, 'unknown app')
    WHEN billing_origin_product = 'AGENT_BRICKS' THEN COALESCE(endpoint_name, 'unknown KA')
    WHEN billing_origin_product = 'VECTOR_SEARCH' THEN COALESCE(endpoint_name, 'VS')
    WHEN billing_origin_product = 'LAKEBASE' THEN sku_name
    ELSE billing_origin_product
  END AS detail,
  CASE
    WHEN workspace_id = '2865348338307293' THEN 'DEV'
    WHEN workspace_id = '3155144190025826' THEN 'UAT'
    WHEN workspace_id = '1210945332048776' THEN 'PROD (LEAP-Core)'

    percentile_approx(first_token_s, 0.5) AS first_token_p50,

datasets.name: doc_diagnostic
queryLines:
WITH rev0 AS (
  SELECT document_revision_ID AS IDDOC, document_reference AS ref, document_title AS titre, published_date,
         revision_status_code, lifecycle_state_code, is_hidden, root_category_ID, category_ID_path,
         last(CASE WHEN root_category_ID IS NOT NULL THEN struct(root_category_ID AS rc, category_ID_path AS cp) END, true)
           OVER (PARTITION BY document_reference ORDER BY document_revision_ID
                 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS earlier
  FROM prod_gold.quality_system.document_revisions_intraqual
),
rev AS (
  SELECT IDDOC, ref, titre, published_date, revision_status_code, lifecycle_state_code, is_hidden,
         COALESCE(root_category_ID, earlier.rc) AS root_category_ID,
         CASE WHEN root_category_ID IS NULL THEN earlier.cp ELSE category_ID_path END AS category_ID_path
  FROM rev0
),
cat AS (
  SELECT ancestor_category_ID AS id, first(ancestor_category_name) AS name
  FROM prod_gold.quality_system.category_ancestors_intraqual GROUP BY ancestor_category_ID
),
cur AS (
  SELECT ref, MAX(IDDOC) AS current_iddoc FROM rev WHERE revision_status_code = 1 GROUP BY ref
),
pd AS (
  SELECT IDDOC, ref AS pd_ref, titre AS pd_titre, indice, parse_status, error_trace, source_file_name,
         source_file_extension, source_file_size_bytes
  FROM dev_proj.qualibot.parsed_documents
),
ck AS (
  SELECT IDDOC, MAX(ref) AS ck_ref FROM dev_proj.qualibot.parsing_checkpoint GROUP BY IDDOC
),
ch AS (
  SELECT IDDOC, COUNT(*) AS n_chunks FROM dev_proj.qualibot.chunks GROUP BY IDDOC
),
excl AS (
  SELECT IDDOC, MAX(reason) AS reason FROM dev_proj.qualibot.rag_exclusions GROUP BY IDDOC
),
ids AS (
  SELECT IDDOC FROM rev UNION SELECT IDDOC FROM pd UNION SELECT IDDOC FROM ck
),
j AS (
  SELECT
    i.IDDOC,
    COALESCE(rev.ref, pd.pd_ref, ck.ck_ref) AS ref,
    COALESCE(rev.titre, pd.pd_titre) AS titre,
    pd.indice, rev.published_date, cat.name AS root_category,
    rev.revision_status_code, rev.lifecycle_state_code, rev.is_hidden,
    pd.parse_status, pd.error_trace, pd.source_file_name, pd.source_file_extension,
    ROUND(pd.source_file_size_bytes / 1024.0, 1) AS file_size_kb,
    COALESCE(ch.n_chunks, 0) AS n_chunks,
    cur.current_iddoc,
    excl.reason AS exclusion_reason,
    rev.IDDOC IS NOT NULL AS in_intraqual,
    ck.IDDOC IS NOT NULL AS has_checkpoint,
    pd.IDDOC IS NOT NULL AS has_parsed_row,
    (rev.root_category_ID IN (3870, 948, 3209, 12, 962, 3208, 4001, 3867) OR exists(rev.category_ID_path, x -> x IN (3967, 4006))) AS in_categories
  FROM ids i
    LEFT JOIN rev ON rev.IDDOC = i.IDDOC
    LEFT JOIN cat ON cat.id = rev.root_category_ID
    LEFT JOIN cur ON cur.ref = rev.ref
    LEFT JOIN pd ON pd.IDDOC = i.IDDOC
    LEFT JOIN ck ON ck.IDDOC = i.IDDOC
    LEFT JOIN ch ON ch.IDDOC = i.IDDOC
    LEFT JOIN excl ON excl.IDDOC = i.IDDOC
),
v AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN n_chunks > 0 THEN '01 IN CHATBOT'
      WHEN NOT in_intraqual THEN '02 NOT IN INTRAQUAL'
      WHEN revision_status_code <> 1 THEN '03 NOT CURRENT REVISION'
      WHEN lifecycle_state_code <> 7 THEN '04 NOT PUBLISHED'
      WHEN is_hidden THEN '05 HIDDEN'
      WHEN NOT in_categories THEN '06 CATEGORY OUT OF SCOPE'
      WHEN exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL OR parse_status IN ('SKIPPED_REF_MANUAL', 'SKIPPED_CATEGORY_EXCLUDED')
        THEN '08 MANUAL EXCLUSION'
      WHEN parse_status = 'SKIPPED_SUPERSEDED_REVISION' THEN '09 REPLACED BY NEWER REVISION'
      WHEN NOT has_parsed_row AND has_checkpoint THEN '10 PARSED, RESULT NOT BUILT'
      WHEN NOT has_parsed_row THEN '11 NOT PROCESSED YET'
      WHEN parse_status = 'ERROR' THEN '12 PARSE ERROR'
      WHEN parse_status = 'EMPTY_TEXT' THEN '13 NO TEXT, NEEDS OCR'
      WHEN parse_status = 'IMAGES_PENDING' THEN '14 IMAGES TO DESCRIBE'
      WHEN parse_status = 'SKIP_TOO_LARGE' THEN '15 FILE TOO LARGE'
      WHEN parse_status IN ('SKIPPED_EMPTY_SMALL_FILE', 'SKIPPED_EMPTY_IMAGES') THEN '16 EMPTY DOCUMENT'
      WHEN parse_status = 'SKIPPED_EMPTY_FOLDER' THEN '17 NO FILE ON VOLUME'
      WHEN parse_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN '18 PARSED BUT NO PASSAGE'
      ELSE '19 OTHER STATUS'
    END AS reason
  FROM j
)
SELECT
  ref, IDDOC, titre, indice, published_date, root_category, reason,
  CASE LEFT(reason, 2)
    WHEN '01' THEN CONCAT(CAST(n_chunks AS STRING), ' passages in the chunks table (the index follows its next sync)')
    WHEN '02' THEN 'Absent from the Intraqual tables: deleted at the source, or an identifier that never existed'
    WHEN '03' THEN CONCAT('An older revision (revision_status_code=', CAST(revision_status_code AS STRING),
                          '); the current one is IDDOC ', COALESCE(CAST(current_iddoc AS STRING), 'none (REF withdrawn)'))
    WHEN '04' THEN CONCAT('Not published: lifecycle_state_code=', CAST(lifecycle_state_code AS STRING), ' (only 7 is published)')
    WHEN '05' THEN 'Hidden in Intraqual (is_hidden = true)'
    WHEN '06' THEN CONCAT('Root category "', COALESCE(root_category, 'none'), '" is not in the indexed scope')
    WHEN '08' THEN CONCAT('Manual exclusion', COALESCE(CONCAT(': ', exclusion_reason), ''))
    WHEN '09' THEN CONCAT('Older revision of the same REF; only the newest revision is indexed (current IDDOC ',
                          COALESCE(CAST(current_iddoc AS STRING), '?'), ')')
    WHEN '10' THEN 'A parsed text exists in the checkpoint but the passage tables were not rebuilt for it: the next run builds it'
    WHEN '11' THEN 'In scope, never processed: the next pipeline run picks it up'
    WHEN '12' THEN CONCAT('Parsing failed (retried by the next run): ', COALESCE(LEFT(error_trace, 200), ''))
    WHEN '13' THEN 'No text could be extracted (scan) and the file is above the empty-file threshold: waiting for OCR'
    WHEN '14' THEN 'No text, images still to be described by the vision model'
    WHEN '15' THEN 'File above the size ceiling of its format: not parsed'
    WHEN '16' THEN 'No text or no usable image, and a file of at most 50 KiB: treated as empty'
    WHEN '17' THEN 'No parseable file in the Intraqual volume folder of this document'
    WHEN '18' THEN 'Parsing succeeded but produced no passage; the pipeline marks it MISSING_CHUNKS on its next run'
    ELSE CONCAT('Status ', COALESCE(parse_status, 'unknown'))
  END AS explanation,
  parse_status, source_file_name, source_file_extension, file_size_kb, n_chunks, current_iddoc
FROM v
ORDER BY ref, IDDOC DESC

1. **IN CHATBOT**: passages exist in the chunks table.

## Methodology & Scope

**Included (Databricks-billed, `system.billing.usage`)**: Jobs whose name contains `qualibot` or is tagged `project=Qualibot` (covers every environment, including jobs that run as `run_as=job-runner-sa-uat`, which the old query missed entirely); the `qualibot` Vector Search endpoint (the only one that exists in this workspace); every `ka-*` Agent Bricks endpoint except `ka-df2b7829-endpoint` (a Knowledge Assistant belonging to a different project, `hackaton_intraqual`, that happens to share the same naming convention); the `qualibot*` apps; the Lakebase project whose uid exactly matches Qualibot's own project (other `LAKEBASE` rows in the same workspaces belong to other teams' Postgres projects and are excluded).

**Excluded / not attributable**: direct calls to shared foundation-model endpoints (`databricks-claude-*`, `databricks-gpt-*`) carry NO identity metadata in `system.billing.usage` (verified) - there is no way to attribute a row to a specific caller from billing data alone. Compare's cost (it calls these endpoints directly, outside any Knowledge Assistant) is shown below instead, sourced from the app's own per-request accounting (`cost_eur`) - an estimate, not a separate Databricks bill line. The `CAPS_WAREHOUSE_ID` SQL warehouse (permission checks) is shared with other apps and is not included. A few historical residual rows (already-deleted Vector Search/KA endpoints) can't be attributed with confidence and are excluded rather than guessed at.
